records.body: What's the difference between the Starter and Pro plans in terms of API rate limits?

records.subject: Re: API rate limits
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

They do differ: API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter.

Thanks so much,
Tariq Diallo

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 (fast start) and kickoff call held 2026-07-13 [calendar:32033172] show real engagement, but no invites sent and no reply to outreach [email:abdbb036, email:abb3e0ac]; milestone often needs a teammate. 8 days left keeps odds near even-to-moderate.

draft.subject: Following up on yesterday's kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff yesterday — good to talk through how your team works. You've already got your first project set up, which is the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, with tasks living inside them.

The natural next step is bringing a teammate in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week? Happy to help get the first invites out.

Best,
Priya
